thread:
mira: Heads-up — joint webinar with CloudHarbor next Wed 10am ET. Need final speaker list, demo machine plan, and swag pickup contact by EOD Friday.
sam: Got it. I have speaker slides from CloudHarbor but waiting on internal approvals. ETA: tomorrow noon.
kai: Demo checklist: 1) staging VM with pinned model 2) local dataset 3) fallback video. Who owns on-site AV in NYC?
mira: @natalie you were sorting NYC AV vendors? Can you confirm contact + mic count?
natalie: Confirmed vendor = BrightStage. They're supplying 2 lavs, 1 handheld, and HDMI switch. I'll drop contact card and arrival window in the thread.
sam: Quick note on demos — partner wants to show a live deploy to their marketplace. We need a safe sandbox command. Recommend this snippet in the runbook:
```
# deploy to sandbox
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/deploy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"image":"example-integrator:stable","env":"sandbox"}'
```
kai: Also packing a pre-recorded 3m fallback. If live deploy fails, we cue fallback at T+8 mins.
mira: Swag — partner shipping 300 stickers + 100 hoodies. Customs forms need commercial invoice: contact AmyOps@partners for signature. Who's tracking incoming courier?
natalie: I'll be onsite to receive. Shipping address: BrightStage, 14 W 29th St, NYC — I'll forward full courier ETA when available.
sam: Speakers: CloudHarbor will bring 2 engineers + 1 PM. Please confirm bios (200 words max) and headshots by Tuesday.
kai: One more: remote speaker in APAC will present live at 7pm JST. Need to set the Zoom co-host, run a connectivity check Mon 2pm PT. @mira can you schedule?
mira: Scheduling now. Also adding a pre-event run from the stage at 9am ET on Wed — 30m dry-run including AV cues and slide handoffs.
devops-bot: Reminder: scheduled recording will auto-start at 9:55am ET. Use #webinar-recording if you need manual override.
sam: Can someone volunteer to be demo liaison during live Q&A to handle creds and throttle? I can triage but prefer a second pair.
natalie: I'll be demo liaison on-site. @sam please handle remote host handoffs.
mira: Perfect — last call: confirm final run-of-show + one‑page speaker cheat by EOD Friday. If anything slips, we default to prerecord + Q&A-only flow. :thumbsup:
